arcs.title: The Biscuit Tin Endgame
arcs.summary: Day 2: A second object — the oven mitt, previously in cheerful disorder on the pot rack — has been found folded and precisely placed on the larder shelf adjacent to the biscuit tin, exactly fourteen inches away. No biscuit is missing. Lucy appears serene and has not looked at the tin. Pemwick, on secondment, has measured the gap and noted the coincidence with the amber duck's hat wingspan in writing. Household analysts have upgraded their assessment of Lucy from 'concerning' to 'architectural.' Day 3 should bring a decisive escalation: either a biscuit finally disappears with surgical precision and zero evidence (Lucy's masterwork), or a third object is found placed — something that reveals the configuration is not random but deliberate, perhaps forming a shape or pointing toward something, suggesting Lucy's campaign has a destination, not just a method. The household should begin to suspect they are not the investigators in this situation.
